annotations.title: United States: full income tax return 2026

description: The complete United States income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: All five filing statuses; married couples always computed jointly and separately, head of household against single; Standard vs itemized deductions: SALT cap $40,400 with the high-income phase-down, mortgage interest and PMI, charity with the 0.5% floor, medical over 7.5%, the 2/37 limit; 2026 brackets, qualified dividends and long-term gains at 0/15/20%, capital loss limit and carryover, AMT with the 50% exemption phase-out; Child tax credit, credit for other dependents, earned income credit, child and dependent care credit, education credits; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in USD; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: An individual's US federal income tax return (Form 1040 or 1040-NR) with the state return, tax year 2026 (calendar year; return due 15 April 2027). Every amount is in US dollars for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

hsa_direct.description: HSA contributions made yourself, not through payroll, US dollars for 2026

se_health_insurance.description: Self-employed health insurance premiums, US dollars for 2026

se_retirement.description: SEP-IRA / solo 401(k) contributions as self-employed, US dollars for 2026

student_loan_interest.description: Student loan interest paid (max $2,500), US dollars for 2026

car_loan_interest.description: Interest on a loan for a new US-assembled car for personal use, bought after 2024 (max $10,000), US dollars for 2026

care_children.description: Children under 13 in paid care while you work (child and dependent care credit)

child_care_expenses.description: Child care costs paid so you could work (max $3,000 for one child, $6,000 for two or more), US dollars for 2026

children_under_17.description: Children under 17 with a Social Security number (child tax credit $2,200 each)

deduction.description: best (the larger), standard or itemized. Default best

eitc_children.description: Qualifying children for the earned income credit (under 19, or under 24 in school). Default: children under 17

estimated_payments.description: Federal estimated tax payments for 2026 (Form 1040-ES), US dollars for 2026

filing.description: Filing date and last year, for penalties and interest

extension.description: Extension filed (Form 4868): filing due 15 October 2027, payment still due 15 April

filed_on.description: Date the return is filed and the balance paid, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 2027-04-15 (the due date)

prior_year_agi.description: AGI on your 2025 return (110% rule above $150,000), US dollars for 2026

prior_year_tax.description: Total tax on your 2025 return (estimated-tax safe harbour), US dollars for 2026

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), mfs (married filing separately), hoh (head of household) or qss (qualifying surviving spouse). Married couples see both joint and separate computed. Default single

foreign.description: Income from abroad (US citizens and residents are taxed on worldwide income)

earned_spouse.description: Of your spouse's wages: earned while living abroad, US dollars for 2026

earned_you.description: Of your wages: earned while living abroad (foreign earned income exclusion up to $132,900), US dollars for 2026

method.description: best (both computed, cheaper one used), feie (foreign earned income exclusion, Form 2555) or ftc (foreign tax credit, Form 1116)

other_income.description: Foreign investment and other income included above, US dollars for 2026

tax_paid.description: Foreign income tax paid (for the foreign tax credit), US dollars for 2026

long_term_carryover.description: Long-term capital loss carried over from 2025, US dollars for 2026

long_term_gains.description: Net long-term capital gain incl. capital gain distributions; a loss as negative

ordinary_dividends.description: Ordinary dividends, including qualified, US dollars for 2026

qualified_dividends.description: Of those, qualified dividends (taxed at 0/15/20%), US dollars for 2026

real_estate_gains.description: Of the long-term gains: gains on real estate (outside Washington's capital gains tax), US dollars for 2026

short_term_carryover.description: Short-term capital loss carried over from 2025, US dollars for 2026

short_term_gains.description: Net short-term capital gain (held one year or less); a loss as negative

tax_exempt_interest.description: Tax-exempt (municipal bond) interest, US dollars for 2026

iso_spread.description: Bargain element of incentive stock options exercised and kept at year end (alternative minimum tax), US dollars for 2026

itemized.description: Itemized deductions (Schedule A); the better of these and the standard deduction is used

charity_cash.description: Cash gifts to charity, US dollars for 2026

charity_noncash.description: Gifts of property to charity (fair value), US dollars for 2026

medical.description: Medical and dental expenses not reimbursed (deductible above 7.5% of AGI), US dollars for 2026

mortgage_balance.description: Average mortgage balance, for the $750,000 limit (0 = within the limit), US dollars for 2026

mortgage_grandfathered.description: Mortgage from before 16 December 2017 ($1 million limit)

mortgage_insurance.description: Mortgage insurance premiums (PMI), US dollars for 2026

mortgage_interest.description: Home mortgage interest (Form 1098), US dollars for 2026

other.description: Other itemized deductions (gambling losses up to winnings, casualty losses in a disaster area), US dollars for 2026

personal_property_tax.description: Personal property tax (e.g. car tax by value), US dollars for 2026

real_estate_tax.description: Real estate (property) tax, US dollars for 2026

state_income_tax.description: State and local income tax paid in 2026. Default: the state tax this return computes, US dollars for 2026

local_rate.description: Other local income tax as a rate on state taxable income, e.g. 0.032 for a Maryland county (0 to 0.1)

dividend_rate.description: US tax rate on dividends: 0.30, or the treaty rate (e.g. 0.15)

fica_exempt.description: F, J, M or Q visa: exempt from Social Security and Medicare

nyc.description: New York City resident (NYC income tax, with state NY)

other.description: Any other taxable income, US dollars for 2026

pensions.description: Taxable pensions, annuities and IRA / 401(k) distributions, US dollars for 2026

rental.description: Net rental income from Schedule E; a loss as negative

rental_active.description: You actively manage the rental (up to $25,000 of loss allowed). Default true

social_security.description: Social Security benefits received (SSA-1099 box 5), US dollars for 2026

other_dependents.description: Other dependents: children 17+, parents, relatives (credit $500 each)

qbi.description: Qualified business income deduction (section 199A) details for the self-employed

sstb.description: Specified service business: law, health, consulting, financial services, performing arts...

ubia.description: Unadjusted basis of business property, US dollars for 2026

w2_wages.description: W-2 wages the business paid, US dollars for 2026

renter.description: You rent your home (California renter's credit)

dependent_care_fsa.description: Of those, the dependent-care FSA (max $7,500), US dollars for 2026

hsa_payroll.description: Health Savings Account (HSA) contributions through payroll, US dollars for 2026
